title: Filament end clip for a spool rim
prompt: Little clip that slides onto the rim of a filament spool so the loose end doesn't unwind. It's a 20 x 14 mm block, 6 mm thick, with a slot 3.2 mm wide and 10 mm deep coming up from the middle of the bottom edge for the spool flange (mine are about 3 mm thick). Put a 2.2 mm hole on each side of the slot, 5 mm up from the bottom edge and 4.2 mm in from the side edge, to thread the 1.75 mm filament through.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
Two 2.2 mm filament holes (2.1–2.4), 11.6 mm apart
Each filament hole is 4.2 mm from its side edge and 5 mm up from the bottom
Ten flat faces: the 8-sided outline with its rectangular slot, plus front and back
The slot opens to the bottom edge (it's part of the outline), so there are only the two holes
Volume (20·14 − 3.2·10 − 2·Ø2.2)·6 ≈ 1442.4 mm³ ±0.5% (a 3.0 slot or an 8 mm deep one is off by >0.8%)

notes: Spool flanges are typically 2.5–3 mm; 3.2 slot for a slip fit.
